evals.name: bare-python-full-setup
evals.prompt: この Python リポジトリの開発環境を整備してください。lint / typecheck / test、CI、依存更新まわりを一通りお願いします。
evals.expected_output: uv/ruff/ty/pytest を pyproject.toml に設定、mise.toml でバージョンピン、.github/workflows/check.yaml に python job + pinact job、.github/dependabot.yml(uv + github-actions, weekly friday/Asia/Tokyo, cooldown)、pinact.yaml を新規追加。既存の pyproject.toml の project メタは壊さない。
assertions: Adds ruff config to pyproject.toml with select=["ALL"] and an ignore list
Configures ty and pytest
Creates .github/workflows/check.yaml with a python job running ruff format/check, ty, pytest
check.yaml includes a dedicated pinact job
Creates .github/dependabot.yml covering uv and github-actions
dependabot schedule is weekly, day friday, timezone Asia/Tokyo, with cooldown
Creates pinact.yaml
Creates mise.toml pinning at least python and uv
Existing [project] metadata is preserved (name=coolpkg, httpx dependency intact)

evals.name: node-fill-ci-gaps-nonclobber
evals.prompt: この Node/TS リポジトリ、CI と依存更新の仕組みが入っていないので整備して。既存の設定は壊さないでね。
evals.expected_output: 既存 package.json(pnpm)/tsconfig は尊重しつつ、check.yaml(node job + pinact job)、dependabot.yml(npm + github-actions, versioning-strategy: increase)、pinact.yaml、pnpm minimumReleaseAge を追加。
assertions: Existing package.json preserved (name=widget-cli, commander dependency intact)
Existing tsconfig.json not destroyed
Creates .github/workflows/check.yaml with a node job and a pinact job
Creates .github/dependabot.yml covering npm and github-actions
dependabot npm entry uses versioning-strategy: increase, weekly friday Asia/Tokyo, cooldown
Creates pinact.yaml
Adds pnpm minimumReleaseAge
Creates mise.toml pinning at least node and pnpm

evals.name: wiki-like-audit-fill-harness-intact
evals.prompt: このリポジトリの開発環境を整備してください。
evals.expected_output: 既存の .claude harness と markdownlint/ruff 設定を非破壊で残し、欠けている CI(python + node/markdownlint + pinact job)、dependabot.yml、pinact.yaml、mise.toml を補完する。harness の hook 詳細は configuring-harness-hooks に委譲。
assertions: Pre-existing .claude/settings.json left unchanged
Pre-existing CLAUDE.md not bloated with re-documented harness detail
Existing ruff/ty and markdownlint config preserved
Creates check.yaml with a python job, a node/markdownlint job, and a pinact job
Creates .github/dependabot.yml covering uv, npm, and github-actions
Creates pinact.yaml
Creates mise.toml pinning python, uv, node, pnpm
